dialogues.speaker: Nabiya
dialogues.text: Sweetness is the most terrifying temptation. You must know how to enjoy happiness, yet not lose yourself in it.

dialogues.speaker: Nabiya
dialogues.text: It's like how eating too many Candied Ajilenakh Nuts can give you cavities. Too much sweetness is suffering.

dialogues.speaker: Nabiya
dialogues.text: See, even Harut and Marut understand this truth.

dialogues.speaker: Nabiya
dialogues.text: You definitely look like a most fortunate person, but they don't seem to be clinging to you, now do they?
